meta.description: Learn the foundational magical systems of House Pendale: Pulse Resonance, Wordframe, and Covenant.

hero.title: This world runs on rules you can feel.
hero.support: The Pendaleverse runs on embodied, linguistic, and oath-bound foundations. Learn the three systems that give the House its current, its grammar, and the price of stepping fully inside it.

media.alt: A ritual room inside House Pendale

sections.title: Three systems. Clean edges. Real consequence.
sections.body: Trust begins with proof that a world's power means something. These three systems form the public foundation of House Pendale, and each one changes what can happen once you cross the threshold.

sections.title: Some doors deserve their own room.
sections.body: These three systems create practices, disciplines, and effects that reach further than a single overview page should try to pin down. The public site will name the foundation here and let the deeper edges unfold elsewhere, with more care and more space.
sections.microcopy: The book shows what the systems feel like in motion.

sections.title: Read the edges where they belong.
sections.body: For longer essays, evolving interpretations, and system notes that need room to breathe, Substack is the better chamber.
